title: API crashes after a deploy
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the api component, the missing package causing crash, and the deploy as the trigger.
root_cause: The April 26 deployment of api 2.3.2 added an import of pydantic_settings without installing the package, causing the API container to crash and return 502 errors.
truth: api 2.3.2 imports the pydantic_settings library, but it isn't installed in the image, so the app crashes on start (exit code 1) and Docker keeps restarting it.
check_first: Inspect the API container logs and health check endpoint to confirm it is running and responding.
